title: archangelica archangelica
intro: Archangelica archangelica, commonly known as Angelica, is a perennial plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to Europe and Asia. It is known for its edible roots and leaves, as well as its medicinal properties. Angelica has been used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Angelica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as volatile oils (e.g., angelic acid, isobutyl angelate), flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
